intro: Trying to find first generation scholarships in Massachusetts with awards under the lower funding range usually means balancing fit, effort, and timing at the same time. This filtered USA view brings together a focused set of listings where award amounts, eligibility details, and deadline wording can differ from row to row. Many of the programs in this slice appear to have lighter application signals, and several listings may be no essay, but you should still read each requirement line carefully before you apply. The mix here leans toward STEM, biology, education, and humanities, so it is worth comparing both topic fit and location relevance instead of assuming every option works the same way.

faq.question: Can I apply to every scholarship listed here if I’m a first-generation student in Massachusetts?
faq.answer: Not automatically. This catalog slice helps you find relevant options, but each program can set its own rules for study level, field of study, residency, or other requirements on the official page.

faq.question: What should I compare before I apply?
faq.answer: Check the award amount, deadline, study level, and subject area row by row. In this Massachusetts set, amounts vary by listing and deadlines differ by program, so verify both on the official source before you apply.

faq.question: Are these mostly STEM scholarships, or can I explore other subjects too?
faq.answer: Many listings in this filtered set connect to STEM and biology, but you can also find education and humanities examples. If you want to explore beyond one subject, compare the category labels and fields of study shown on each listing.
